content.short: A retro pixel art and collection based NFT Game on Cardano.
content.description: The game Cardano Warriors was born from our love of video games, our technology enthusiasm and the idea of making a real difference in the Non-fungible Token (NFT) projects scenery during the early Cardano Network stages. We focused on bringing an unique and exclusive art collection during the first stage, celebrating the Golden Era console RPG video games that were made in eight and sixteen bits. Our collection brought value to its parties, moving an entire buying and selling NFTs economy.
content.meta: Find out about Cardano Warriors (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
